features.note: The aperture slider under the swatch sets the mean of a 1 to 31 pixel square around the pointer, and the loupe outlines that square; the state is tested in window.rs. Gap: an even size is not centred on the pointer pixel, and the slider has not been checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: the slider drags from 1 to 31 pixels and the loupe outline follows it.

features.note: The View > Magnification items set the loupe to 7, 11, 15, 21, 31 or 41 cells, with a check on the current size; the items are tested in menu.rs. Not checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: View > Magnification items change the loupe size. The sizes are a fixed list (7 to 41 cells), not a free slider.

features.feature: Display values in colour space (native, sRGB, P3, Adobe RGB, Generic RGB)
features.apple: View > Display in sRGB, Display in Adobe RGB, Display native values
features.note: View > Display In chooses Native, sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB or Generic RGB, and color.rs converts the reading with tested reference values. Gaps: Native is the delivered sRGB codes unconverted, and Generic RGB is a 1.8 gamma approximation on sRGB primaries. Not checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: View > Display In moves the readout between the five spaces. Native equals sRGB until the shell exposes the panel profile.

features.note: View > Display Values chooses the format that Copy and the Copy as row use, and the readout lists hex, 8-bit, 16-bit and percent together; the codes and the copy text are tested in color.rs. Not checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: the format chosen in View > Display Values is the one Copy Color as Text puts on the clipboard.

features.feature: Lock position, Lock X, Lock Y
features.apple: View > Lock Position, Lock X, Lock Y
features.note: Lock Position (cmd+L), Lock X Coordinate (cmd+X) and Lock Y Coordinate (cmd+Y) are View items over a Pointer model that locks each axis on its own; the Pointer row names the locked axis, and loupe.rs tests the locks. Shortcut delivery through the shell is not checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: cmd+L, cmd+X and cmd+Y reach the app through the menu and lock the axes independently.

features.note: View > Show Mouse Location hides and shows the Position row of the readout, and window.rs tests both states. Not checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: the View item hides and shows the Position row.

features.note: Color > Copy Color as Text (shift+cmd+C) and the toolbar Copy button give the same text in the chosen format, and menu.rs tests that they match. Not checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: shift+cmd+C puts the reading on the clipboard in the chosen format.

features.note: Color > Copy Color as Image (alt+cmd+C) puts a 64 by 64 swatch of the reading on the clipboard. The outcome is tested in menu.rs; the clipboard write is shell code and is not tested headless. Not checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: alt+cmd+C puts a swatch image on the clipboard.

features.note: View > Update Continuously sets the sampling gate in window.rs: when it is off, the loupe is asked again only when the readout pixel or the loupe size changes, and the window tests cover both modes. Not checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: the View check follows the toggle, and with it off the loupe stops refreshing while the readout pixel stays put.

features.note: The View and Color menus come from ColorMeter::menus and are returned by main_menu; the ids, shortcuts, checks and enabled state are tested in menu.rs. Not checked on Midget.
features.wire: Check on Midget: the View and Color menus appear in the menu bar while the app is in front, with checks following the state.

features.apple: Display native values EDR, EDR Linear
features.note: Tied to the platform HDR display pipeline.
